Last month @BrownHopeOrg hosted our first donor appreciation event of the year! 

Together we shared space to laugh, to cry and to heal. Grateful to everyone who has supported me and Brown Hope these last six months. 

We’re stronger because of you. 

#pdx #blacklivesmatter 🖤✊🏾 https://t.co/vOkWM4kdZ0

Starting Friday, any donations to BRF during the next week will be DOUBLED up to $5,000. 

All dollars raised will directly fund Year Two of BRF’s village building program with an income guarantee. 

Thank you all for the ongoing support. Let’s do this!! 

#blacklivesmatter ✊🏾🖤
